policy: Explicit current dated cell-note score publications supplement blank or conflicting clean-tab rows. Historical, oracle, functional-only and other-context fractions are not substituted. Nonempty unambiguous clean-tab scores are preserved.

scores.note: Latest explicit score publication in the cell note supplements the stale blank clean-tab score. Historical notes, usage limits and benchmark-version qualifications remain in the original comment.
